name: A late world-entry notice after the fallback stream is not answered again
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. SMSG_PATCH_LOADING_SCREENS (0x05F8) opens every display patch stream. A
client that has not sent CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED (0x561) within 5 s of login receives the stream from the
login fallback timer. A notice arriving after that stream belongs to the same login, whose rows the client
already holds, so it must not stream again, also past the former ten-second resend cooldown.

steps.label: No world-entry notice: let the 5 s fallback fire
DISCRIMINATING: the late notice is not answered with a second stream
